premises.text: Social TV and other interactive uses require processing and broadcasting gargantuan real-time data streams back to audiences quickly—a hard problem historically limited to elite organizations
premises.evidence_span: That's a real-time big data problem, where you have to take that deluge of data, you have to process it, and then you have to transmit it back out to the audience very, very quickly

premises.text: Bright Context is a cloud platform for developers to process in-flight real-time data streams and push/broadcast results via an easy API
premises.evidence_span: cloud-based platform for software developers that makes it easy to do two key things

premises.text: Through and quant channels in a web dashboard configure inputs, continuous filtering/calculations, and outputs linked to apps with an SDK
premises.evidence_span: through channel, which is for broadcasting data without processing it. And then there's a quant channel

premises.text: One package combines stream processing and broadcast/push, stores real-time history, and lowers barriers via dashboard, API, and cloud pricing
premises.evidence_span: we provide both data stream processing as well as data broadcast and push in one package

premises.text: Adoption will be driven by self-service developers across social TV, business metrics, gaming, and mobile use cases
premises.evidence_span: engaging developers directly through a self-service model

domains.name: real-time big data for interactive audiences

value.text: Developers can build real-time interactive experiences without owning elite-scale backend infrastructure
value.evidence_span: dramatically lowering the barrier to entry to very sophisticated back-end technology

secondary_value.text: Audiences get real-time insight into collective sentiment (e.g., Election Meter social TV)
